text.p: The hospital drama "ER" was nominated for 22 Primetime Emmy Awards Thursday, helping top rated NBC lead its network rivals with 89 nominations for TV's top honours.
But the cable station Home Box Office edged out NBC, receiving 90 nods, including 16 for its comedy series "The Larry Sanders Show" and 12 for the civil rights miniseries "Miss Evers' Boys."
CBS came in third place in terms of overall nominations, with 60, followed by ABC with 44 and Fox with 19.

Ellen DeGeneres, whose ABC comedy series "Ellen" made television history earlier this year when her character announced she was homosexual, was nominated for best actress for a comedy series -- one of five nominations for the show.

But Rich Frank, president of the Academy of Television Arts & Sciences, said he saw the nomination as a tribute to DeGeneres' talent rather than the groundbreaking episode. "Ellen is going to be a star for a long time. The entire gay issue is just another issue. She's an unbelievable talent," he said.

The show "Ellen", however, was not nominated for best comedy series. NBC again dominated that category, receiving nominations for "Frasier", "Mad About You", "Seinfeld" and "3rd Rock From The Sun". The other best comedy series nomination went to HBO's "Larry Sanders Show".

Another NBC hit show, "Friends", did not receive a nomination, although it was erroneously announced as a nominee when Frank went live on national television to list the main contenders. Frank said afterwards he had used last year's list of nominees during rehearsals, and then forgot to take "Friends" off the updated list.
"As soon as it ended, I knew I had made a mistake," he said.
The shows nominated for best drama series were hospital dramas "Chicago Hope", and "ER", police dramas "Law & Order" and "N.Y.P.D. Blue", and science fiction drama "The X-Files".
Paralysed "Superman" actor Christopher Reeve received a nomination for his directorial debut in the HBO miniseries "In The Gloaming", which received four other nominations.

It was a case of rounding up the usual suspects for the best actor nomination in a drama seres. They went to David Duchovny for "The X-Files", Anthony Edwards for "ER", Dennis Franz for "N.Y.P.D. Blue", Jimmy Smits for "N.Y.P.D. Blue" and Sam Waterston for "Law & Order". But George Clooney, the other main male star of "ER", was not nominated this year.

Actresses nominated for their work in a drama series were Gillian Anderson for "The X-Files", Christine Lahti for "Chicago Hope", Julianna Margulies and Sherry Stringfield, for "ER", and Roma Downey for "Touched by an Angel." Stringfield left "ER" in midseason, saying she found the demands of a television series overwhelming.

Michael J. Fox was nominated for best actor in a comedy series for his work in "Spin City", along with Kelsey Grammer in "Frasier", John Lithgow for "3rd Rock from the Sun", Paul Reiser for "Mad About You", and Garry Shandling for "The Larry Sanders Show.

Besdies DeGeneres, nominations for best actress in a comedy series went to Fran Drescher for "The Nanny", Helen Hunt for "Mad About You", Patricia Richardson for "Home Improvement" and Cybill Shepherd for "Cybill".
The 49th Annual Primetime Emmy Awards ceremony will take place on September 14.
